The '''IM-6 Battlefield Medical Droid''' was a model of [[IM-6 Battlefield Medical Droid/Legends|IM-series]] [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]] manufactured by [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]]. Widely employed, it was used by the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] and was perhaps the most versatile and advanced medical [[Droid/Legends|droid]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
[[File:IM-6_medical_droid_TCWCG.jpg|thumb|left|180px|An IM-6 battlefield medical and a [[DD-13 medical assistant droid/Legends|DD-13 medical assistant droid]] operate on a patient]]
The IM-6 had advanced programming, numerous different tools for various purposes, [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlifts]] for easy maneuverability, internal drug and anesthetic reservoirs and no programming glitches that would cause it to break down in the most critical stages of an operation.

They were small enough to be practical to carry on anything from [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|gunships]]<ref name="AotC ICS">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref><ref name="Gunship DB">{{DB|vehicle|republicgunship|Republic attack gunship}}</ref> to [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TE]] walkers to [[Victory I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory I''-class Star Destroyers]] and were complemented by emergency kits that expanded the [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] abilities even further.

IM-6s were able to zip around on the battlefield, using their nimble repulsorlifts to dodge enemy fire and drag wounded troops to a position of safety where they could be healed.

Their small size made them cheap, and many thousands were produced, making them one of the most prolific [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droids]] of all time. IM-6 units tended to have eager personalities, and tried to make healing and surgery as painless as possible. They usually had a soothing feminine voice with a raspy, synthesized trace.<ref name="Clone Campaigns" />

It shared much of its framework with [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica's]] [[JN-66 analysis droid/Legends|JN-66 analysis droid]], which in turn possessed many of the same components as their less sophisticated [[PK-series worker droid/Legends|PK-series worker droid]] cousin.<ref name="JN-66" />

==Behind the scenes==
The IM-6 medical droid was voiced by [[Diane Michelle]] in the game ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns]]''. Like all the "good guys{{' "}} medical droids, the IM-6 units were friendly, eager, and focused on minimal pain, in contrast to the sadistic droids of the "bad guys."
